# Bali Fishing Trips — Private Fishing Charters in Bali

> Private fishing charters out of Serangan, Bali. Target Mahi Mahi, Yellowfin Tuna, and more on a 36ft yacht with experienced local crew.

## About

Bali Fishing Trips operates private and shared fishing charters from Serangan Harbor, Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia. We run daily trips on a 36ft GT 70 cruiser with an experienced local crew. All trips are all-inclusive: fishing license, hotel/villa pickup, drinks, snacks, and you keep your catch.

- **Website:** https://balifishboat.com
- **Location:** Serangan Harbor, Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia
- **Boat:** 36ft GT 70 cruiser, 2x Yamaha 115HP engines, capacity 8 guests
- **Rating:** 4.4/5 from 126+ verified reviews on FishingBooker

## Fish Species in Bali

| Species | Best Season | Difficulty | Eating Quality |
|---------|-------------|------------|----------------|
| Yellowfin Tuna | May – October | Intermediate | Excellent |
| Mahi Mahi (Dolphinfish) | Year-round (peak Apr–Oct) | Beginner | Excellent |
| Giant Trevally (GT) | May – October | Advanced | Good |
| Skipjack Tuna | November – April | Beginner | Good |
| Red Snapper | Year-round | Beginner | Excellent |
| Grouper | Year-round | Beginner | Excellent |
| Mackerel | Year-round | Beginner | Good |
| Sailfish | June – September | Advanced | Catch and release |
| Marlin | July – August | Advanced | Catch and release |
| Spanish Mackerel | Year-round | Intermediate | Excellent |
| Wahoo | May – October | Intermediate | Excellent |
| Barracuda | Year-round | Intermediate | Good |
| Coral Trout | Year-round | Beginner | Excellent |

## Fishing Techniques

| Technique | Skill Level | Best For |
|-----------|-------------|----------|
| Trolling | Beginner | Tuna, Mahi Mahi, Sailfish, Marlin |
| Jigging | Intermediate | Snapper, Grouper, GT, Tuna |
| Slow Jigging | Intermediate | Snapper, Grouper, Deep species |
| Popping | Advanced | GT, Tuna, Mahi Mahi |
| Bottom Fishing | Beginner | Snapper, Grouper, Mackerel |
| Casting | Beginner | Mahi Mahi, Mackerel, Tuna |
| Live Bait Fishing | Intermediate | GT, Tuna, Sailfish |

| Uluwatu | 45 min by car | May – Sep | 40–100m |
| Nusa Lembongan | 30 min by boat | Apr – Oct | 20–60m |

## Seasonal Guide

| Month | Season | Water Temp | What's Biting |
|-------|--------|------------|---------------|
| January | Wet | 28–30°C | Mahi Mahi, Skipjack, Mackerel, Snapper |
| February | Wet | 28–30°C | Mahi Mahi, Skipjack, Mackerel, Snapper |
| March | Wet | 28–30°C | Mahi Mahi, Skipjack, Red Snapper, Grouper |
| April | Transition | 27–29°C | Yellowfin Tuna, Mahi Mahi, Red Snapper |
| May | Dry | 26–28°C | Yellowfin Tuna, Mahi Mahi, GT, Red Snapper |
| June | Dry | 25–27°C | Yellowfin Tuna, GT, Mahi Mahi, Sailfish |
| July | Dry | 24–26°C | Yellowfin Tuna, GT, Mahi Mahi, Sailfish, Marlin |
| August | Dry | 24–26°C | Yellowfin Tuna, GT, Mahi Mahi, Sailfish, Marlin |
| September | Dry | 25–27°C | Yellowfin Tuna, GT, Mahi Mahi, Sailfish |
| October | Transition | 26–28°C | Yellowfin Tuna, Mahi Mahi, GT, Red Snapper |
| November | Wet | 27–29°C | Mahi Mahi, Skipjack, Red Snapper, Grouper |
| December | Wet | 28–30°C | Mahi Mahi, Skipjack, Mackerel, Snapper |

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What's included in every trip?**
All trips include a fishing license, hotel/villa pickup, drinks and snacks, and you keep your catch. Longer trips also include a meal.

**How many people can the boat hold?**
The boat has a capacity of 8 persons. Our private trips include up to 4 guests in the base price; additional guests can be added.

**What fish can we catch?**
Common catches include Mahi Mahi, Yellowfin Tuna, Skipjack Tuna, Red Snapper, Grouper, and Mackerel. What's biting depends on the season and technique.

**What's your cancellation policy?**
Free cancellation up to 30 days before the trip. Contact us for details on shorter notice.

**Do you offer shared trips?**
Yes! Our Sharing Trip is a 4-hour shared boat experience at $200 per person. We also offer a Sunset Trip at $270 per person (min. 2 guests, includes BBQ dinner).

**Where do we depart from?**
We depart from Serangan Harbor in Denpasar, Bali. We offer pickup from your hotel or villa.

**Can beginners go fishing in Bali?**
Absolutely. Our crew handles all the rigging and guides you through every step. Trolling and bottom fishing are great for beginners — you just hold the rod and enjoy the fight.

**Can kids go fishing in Bali?**
Yes! Kids love it. We recommend the Half-Day or Sharing Trip for families with children.

**Is Bali good for tuna fishing?**
Bali is excellent for tuna. Yellowfin Tuna are caught year-round off Serangan, with peak season from May to October.

**What is the best month for fishing in Bali?**
May through September is the best period — dry season, calm seas, and peak activity for Yellowfin Tuna, GT, Mahi Mahi, and even Marlin.

**What fish bite in July in Bali?**
July is peak season. Expect Yellowfin Tuna, Giant Trevally (GT), Mahi Mahi, Sailfish, and Marlin.

**Can non-fishers join the trip?**
Yes. The boat has shaded seating, a toilet, and comfortable cruising. Non-fishers can relax, snorkel, or just enjoy the ocean views.

**How rough is the ocean in Bali?**
During dry season (May–September), seas around Serangan are generally calm. Wet season can bring rougher conditions, but we monitor weather and offer free rescheduling if unsafe.

**Can we cook the fish we catch?**
On Full Day trips, the crew can prepare a fresh sashimi or grilled fish lunch from your catch.

**Do I need a fishing license?**
No — the fishing license is included in every trip.

**What should I bring?**
Sunscreen, hat, sunglasses, and a camera. We provide all fishing equipment. Wear comfortable clothing and non-slip shoes.
